hermes.version_policy: Pin a stable release or commit for production; do not treat current docs/main as identical to the pinned release.

capabilities.summary: Use Profiles for persistent specialist identity/state. Profile isolation is not an OS security sandbox.
Use Bots as persistent named Profile-based collaborators; do not use chat messages as authoritative workflow state.
Use delegate_task for short isolated fork/join work with explicit context and bounded child execution.
Use output_schema for machine-consumed delegated results while keeping schemas intentionally forgiving.
Use Kanban for durable cross-agent workflow, dependencies, review, blocking, restart recovery, and auditability.
Keep reusable procedures in Skills, project rules in project context files, and persistent identity in SOUL.md.
Use memory for bounded durable facts, not as the primary large architecture knowledge base.
Enforce least privilege through toolsets/MCP filtering rather than relying only on prose restrictions.
Use execute_code for deterministic multi-tool processing/branching where intermediate results need not enter model context.
Select models per role and configure explicit provider/fallback behavior; revalidate routing details on upgrades.
Use Cron for durable scheduled triggers/execution, not as the authoritative cross-agent workflow state store.
Use sandbox/container execution and capability restriction for production isolation; Profiles alone are insufficient.
Correlate workflow, session, turn, API, tool, and child-agent identifiers for end-to-end traces.
